tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kun rig gi bum bskyed bsdus pa bzhugs/

bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi mtshan tsam brjod pa dang*/ /gzungs sngags bzlas pas ngan song las/ thar mdzad bcom ldan kun rig gi /lha tshogs rnams la gus phyag 'tshal/ /kun rig bum bskyed rgyas pa ma lcogs pa'i tshe/ bsdus pa bya tshul cho ga rgyas pa'i rigs 'gros kyis shes pas zur du brjod mi dgos kyang blo gsal 'ga' la 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir du/ bsdus pa byed lugs paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung 'bum du 'byung yang*/ de ni 'di ka'i phyag len dang cung mi 'dra bar snang bas/ 'dir 'dul 'dzin pa'i cho ga'i phyag len dang bstun nas bum bskyed bsdus pa bya tshul ni/ mdun gyi bum pa la dmigs te/ badz+ra yak+ṣa bsangs/ swa bha was stong bar sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las baṃ las byung ba'i bum pa dkar bo zhes pa nas/ yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ oṃ tāp+te nas/ mi phyed par gyur/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du pad zla'i gdan lnga/ dbus kyi gdan la oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das kun rig sku mdog dkar bo nas nyi ma'i 'od kyi rgyab yol mnga' ba phyogs bzhir pad zla'i gdan rnams kyi steng du/ hūṃ las rdo rje zhes pa nas/ āḥlas sna tshogs rdo rje āḥs mtshan pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhir gyur pa ni/ shar du ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyal bo sku mdog dkar bo phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgyas rdo rje dkar bo rtse lnga ba bsnams pa/ zhes pa nas/ byang du me tog cher rgyas ljang khu g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas sna tshogs rdo rje bsnams shing g.yon ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi bo yang*/ zhes pa nas/ nyi ma'i 'od kyi rgyab yol mnga' ba/ gtso bo'i g.yon du pad zla'i gdan la k+ṣaṃ las mche ba k+ṣaṃ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po zhes pa nas/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad las bsdigs pa'i tshul du mdzad cing*/ rab tu dgyes pa('i) spyan gdangs pa/ sgegs pa'i nyams can zhes pa nas/ zla ba'i 'od kyi rgyab yol mnga' ba/ lha tshogs de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar bo nas/ hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ lha rang rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du oṃ la sogs pa'i rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa nas/ bcom ldan 'das kun rig rigs lnga rdo rje gnod sbyin dang bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spyan 'dren rgyas pa 'am cung zad bsdu na/ ma lus sems can zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gi mjug tu/ 'di ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ / zhes pa nas/ de srid bcom ldan 'das bzhugs su gsol/ zhes pa'i bar ram/ yang na sngar gyi tshigs bcad de'i mjug tu/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥm hā kā ru ṇi ka sogs/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs zhes sogs mthar/ ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭhe āḥhūṃ/ zhes pa nas/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ gi bar gyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥnas/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa hoḥ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ de nas mchod yon phul te gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs nas/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra ṭiṣ+ti ma ṭa/ sarba bid tri sh+ye dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ lan gsum/ a haṃ/ sarba bid lan gsum/ oṃ sarba bid sarba ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ne ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum nas/ oṃ sarba bid traṭa/ lan gsum brjod pa'i bar gzhung ltar dang de nas sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra ṭiṣ+ti ma ṭa/ badz+ra yak+ṣa tri sh+ye/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ lan gsum gyi bar brjod/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga ba thog mtha' med pa'i chos nyid kyi ngo bos mtshan par gyur nas/ rdo rje dkar bo rtse lnga ba mthur nyal bas mtshan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra dzī hoḥ o sarba bid sar ā wa ra ṇa

nas/ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bid oṃ nas/ oṃ sarba bid traṭa/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ rdo rje'i lte ba la lha rang rang gi sngags kyis mtshan par gyur/ gar dang klu dang*/ zhes sogs kyi mthar/ sarba bid lan lnga dang*/ badz+ra yak+ṣa/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje mtshan par gyur/ sarba bid lan lnga dang*/ badz+ra yak+ṣa/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan par gyur/ oṃ bung+ngha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ zhes sogs kyis dbang bskur/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs te/ tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas bsam/ yang na/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta pra twits+tsha'i bar brjod/ sgeg sogs brgyad kyis kyang mchod la/ snang stong ma'am/ bsdu na/ chos sku nam mkha' mas rigs lnga dang*/ rdo rje gnod sbyin thabs chen po/ / zhes sogs las rdo rje gnod sbyin la bstod nas/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka hūṃ nyer gcig sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan bdun/ dung chos kyi chu ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byas/ zhes sogs dang*/ bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba'i/ zhes sogs mthar/ rigs lnga'i sngags dang*/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags brgya sogs ci rig pa thun mong du/ rtsa rigs 'dun nam nyer gcig dang mjug tu yig brgya brjod pa sogs lhag ma rnams shes par sla'o/ /ces pa 'di ni/ sbyor ba byed pa'i skabs 'ga' zhig tu nye bar mkho bsam nas bris pa yin la/ kun rig gi bum bskyed rgyas pa byed 'dod kyang ma lcogs pa'i tshe 'di lta bu'i bsdus pa byas na phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag yin pas bya'i rgyas pa lcogs bzhin du 'di mi bya ste/ las dang po bsgom rgyu med pa rnams kyis rgyas pa byed pa'i phyag srol yod pa mnyam par byas na legs kyi/ sla chos kyis bsdus pa byed mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang phyogs 'dir bum bskyed gtan med par lho sgo byed pa'i phyag len snang yang de ni cung legs par mi sems te/

khrus tsam yin na/ bum par lha bskyed pa dang*/ de la dmigs nas sngags bzla dgos pa'i nges pa med kyang*/ lho sgo byed pa'i tshe bsgrub bya'i nad gdon zhi ba dang las nyon gyi dri ma sbyong ba sogs kyi dgos ba che bas/ de la bum par lha bskyed pa'am/ ma tha'ang bum pa'i chu byin gyis rlabs pa'i sngags bzla ba tsam ma byas par lha la khrus gsol ba'i khrus chu tsam la/ bya ba de sgrubs pa'i nus pa khyad par can med pas so/ /der ma zad las bum bsgrubs pa tsam gyis kyang mi chog go /gal te lho sgo'i tshe bum pa lha bskyed pa 'di ltar ma grub na ni/ bum chu la dri bzang btab nas/ bum pa'i nang du zla gdan la oṃ dang hūṃ yig gi mthar bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba de las 'od zer 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyis byin rlabs rnams 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rnam par bkug nas sngags 'phreng la thim par gyur par bsams te/ rtsa rig sogs dang*/ kaṃ ka ni dang yig brgya lta bu ci 'grub bzlas pas rkyang 'grub pa'i skabs yod mod/ dbang gi tshe bum par lha nges par bskyed dgos par kun rig ṭīka chen las bshad do/ /ces bya ba 'di ni bshad sgrub ming can gyis gzhan la phan 'dod kyi bsam pas bris pa ste/ dad ldan ri khrod pa blo bzang bkra shis zhes bgyi bas gzhan la phan ched par du bsgrubs so/ / maṅga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/kun rig gi bum bskyed bsdus pa bzhugs/ - PAGE 230-- PAGE 231-- PAGE 228-
